pr_title: Ensure reindex test exception is not swallowed.
pr_body:
Currently it is possible for an exception in `ReindexFromOldRemoteIT` to
be swallowed if an exception thrown is from the finally block when
deleting the test index. This commit ensures a prior exception is
propagated in this case.

Closes #81997.

review_comments:
I do not think it is required to delete the index again in case of exception.
It is enough to catch and log it inside the finally block to propagate the original exception.

Notice that with the way it is structured now, it could have failed earlier too (for instance in one of the assertions) and in those cases the delete need to be done.

I suppose we could move the line [`idexDeleted = true`](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/85425/files#diff-5cead9923abe48a90807d6356afc5b0805910bd4157cae1b129624fe3461171dR97) line before the attempt to delete the index (i.e., one line up) if we want to avoid the double delete attempt, that seems fine to me.
I mean I would prefer a failed delete in a success case not disappear to a warn message since that is still a concern. But I made a change in this area.

I think the comment above is slightly misleading as this branch would effectively throw exception.
May be reword to `Since the test completed successfully, the delete exception should not be swallowed if present`?
